{{Quote|While the ex-senators and territorial supervisors have been jailed for terms of four years or more, the prime minister has been tried, convicted, and executed for treason. Furthermore, his home city of Tophen—found to be the center of this activity—has already been pacified.|Grand Moff Wilhuff Tarkin, about Tophen|<ref name="LPOA" />}}
'''Tophen''' was a [[city]] on<ref name="LPOA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]]<ref name="Databank">{{Databank|christophsis|Christophsis}}</ref> [[planet]] [[Christophsis]]. By the [[time]] of the [[Imperial Era]], it was the hometown of the planet's [[Unidentified prime minister|prime minister]]. Under the [[Prime Minister|minister's]] direction, Tophen began serving as a center of operations for the [[Christophsis insurgents]], an anti-[[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] resistance group.<ref name="LPOA" />

In [[3 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[Leia, Princess of Alderaan]]'' to [[3 BBY]].</ref> the prime minister was [[Death|executed]] for [[treason]] against the Empire during a [[Arrests on Christophsis|series of arrests]] after the Empire discovered his affiliation with Tophen's rebels. Afterward, Tophen was "pacified" by the Empire for being an insurgent activity hub. [[Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]] announced Tophen's fate in an address to the [[Imperial Senate]], claiming it as a victory for the future of the Empire.<ref name="LPOA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tophen was mentioned in ''[[Leia, Princess of Alderaan]]'', a [[2017]] young-adult novel written by [[Claudia Gray]].<ref name="LPOA" />
